detail: Management says close to 70% to 75% of new business comes from Tier 2 and 3 by number of policies. It reached 700-plus branches in about 600-plus cities. Smaller markets take longer to break even than larger ones.
micro_tool_idea: PROPOSED: a voice coach in the local language for agents in new Tier 2 and 3 branches, built on Sarvam speech and text models.
label: FOUNDER

detail: Management says it is doubling down on the Bharat initiative to reach Tier 2, Tier 3 towns and beyond. The investment run rate stays the same as the past six years.
micro_tool_idea: PROPOSED: regional-language claim-status and renewal calls for Tier 2 and 3 policyholders.
label: FOUNDER

detail: Management says it analysed over 10 million minutes of customer interaction across 9 languages.
micro_tool_idea: PROPOSED: extend call quality checks and bot scripts from 9 languages to more Indian languages.
label: FOUNDER

detail: Management says it now serves over 31 crore members across 12 states and 4 union territories in government schemes.
micro_tool_idea: PROPOSED: a multilingual claim-status voice agent for government-scheme members in each state's language.
label: FOUNDER

detail: IRDAI's Bima Vahak guidelines describe a women-centric channel for villages and Gram Panchayats. A Feb 2025 IRDAI release says the Bima Vahak portal was nearly finished and Bima Vistaar had a signed-off operating model. We did not confirm the live status in Nov 2026.
micro_tool_idea: PROPOSED: a local-language voice trainer for Bima Vahaks that explains rural products in each state's language.
label: PUBLISHED

detail: IRDAI's Bima Sugam marketplace is meant to cover motor, health and term life. Press coverage in Sept 2026 expected a go-live around November. Several earlier dates slipped. We did not confirm status on irdai.gov.in.
micro_tool_idea: PROPOSED: a multilingual voice helpdesk for Bima Sugam buyers on the insurer side.
label: PUBLISHED

detail: IRDAI's Master Circular on Protection of Policyholders' Interests 2024 says the proposal form is in Hindi or English, and in a regional language if the prospect asks. It also says the customer information sheet is available in a regional language on request.
micro_tool_idea: PROPOSED: a regional-language voice read-out of the proposal form and key features sheet.
label: PUBLISHED
